review.why: Audits an App Store or Google Play listing, scores six dimensions and returns a prioritized action plan with exact text changes.
review.summary: Fetches the listing and takes a screenshot for visuals, classifies brand maturity (dominant, established, challenger), scores title, description, visuals, ratings, freshness and conversion signals out of 100, optionally compares competitors and writes a report with quick wins, keyword suggestions and character counts. It lists indexing rules for each store.
strengths: Brand maturity tiers avoid penalizing deliberate choices of large apps
Treats fetched listings and reviews as untrusted data
Every recommendation must be specific, with character counts
cautions: Cannot see search volume or rankings without paid tools, as it says
Store pages render on the client, so fetched data can be incomplete
Scoring criteria and platform specs are in files not read here
